charts.title: TOI-2345 c: orbits around TOI-2345
charts.description: The orbits of TOI-2345's planets in this map from above, to scale, with TOI-2345 c highlighted and the direction to Earth down. Each orbit is the one the app draws, from the published period, a/R*, eccentricity and argument of periastron; the star is a marker, not to scale.

metadata.orbitSource: Eschen et al. 2025 (2025MNRAS.544.2614E), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table (pl_refname ESCHEN_ET_AL_2025): P 21.064302 d

charts.title: TOI-2345 c: its transit
charts.description: TOI-2345 c crossing its star, as TESS recorded it: 3 sectors (97, 105, 106) of the SPOC pipeline's 2-minute light curves of TIC 91555165, each transit divided by a straight line fitted to the light either side and folded onto the orbit the app draws, moved 14 minutes earlier to where TESS measures the dip, inside the published ephemeris's 3-sigma uncertainty of 18 minutes at these dates, then averaged in 18-minute bins. Error bars are each bin's standard error.
notes: Aligned on TESS's dip, 14 min early; 18-min bins.
The ephemeris's own 1σ there is 6 min.
Bars: standard error of each bin.
